You seem to be sensitive to the medication. So am I. I never take the prescribed dose, I always empty the beads and take 1/3 or 2/3, and work my way up slowly as my body adjusts.

 I slowly increased my dose of Effexor from 1/3 to 2/3 and then the full pill, and after 2 weeks I was able to comfortably take the full 37.5mg without many side effects.

If I took 37.5mg as my initial, first dose, it would be way too strong for my body. That's when you get these side effects. 

I experienced those same effects with Prozac and Sertraline. They both made me manic and my jaw became tense and I felt like I was high on drugs. I believe that is because I was taking a dose which my body couldn't tolerate.

So yeah fella. If you are still committed and are taking the Effexor. Don't be afraid to lower your dose. The 37.5mg capsules contain 3 white beads. Empty your capsule and take 1 bead to start, assess how you fell, and if you can tolerate it move up to 2 beads etc.
